entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Latin Kingdom, a political institution in Israel during Early Islamic and Crusader Periods (1099–1291). Grew from First Crusade captures Jerusalem; massacre of Muslim and Jewish inhabitants and Dome of the Rock completed on the Temple Mount. Led to the emergence of First Crusade and Saladin defeats the Crusaders at the Battle of Hattin and recaptures Jerusalem.
